macros.name: centered
macros.doc: The \centered{⟨text⟩} command yields a centered line without vertical spacing.

macros.name: compactlistindent
macros.doc: Indentation length is set by \compactlistindent (fixed at 0.5 em by default) and can be modified with \setlength.

macros.name: cstrut
macros.doc: The \cstrut macro is a alternative of \vstrut that adds a symmetric strut in height and depth relative to the mathematical center line, which is halfway the height of an ‘x’.

macros.name: vstrut
macros.doc: The command \vstrut[⟨depth⟩]{⟨height⟩} produces a strut with a variable height or depth, allowing you to increase the line’s height above the baseline or its depth below (optional).

envs.name: compactlist
envs.doc: As the name suggests, the compactlist environment allows you to create a “compact” list, meaning it has no vertical space above or between items.

envs.name: indentblock
envs.doc: The indentblock environment facilitates the indentation of an entire block of lines.
